 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. FC Augsburg and Manuel Baum will be keen to avoid any surprises as they travel to face third tier side SG Sonnenhof Großaspach at the WIRmachenDRUCK Arena this evening.
 With kick-off scheduled for 18:00 CET in just under an hour's time, you can find the confirmed starting lineups for both teams below.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Confirmed Großaspach vs FC Augsburg lineups:
 Großaspach (4-4-2): Reule – Rahn, Aidonis, Nuraj, Molinari – Lo, Maier, Kunde, Rossmann – Pollex, Eisele
 FC Augsburg (3-4-2-1): Dahmen – Bah, Matsima, Keitel – Seol, Massengo, Rieder Behrens – Fellhauer, Kömür – Ribeiro
